verdict.rationale: Cline offers programmatic control rather than a classic public API. Docs describe building agents and integrations on its core engine (an SDK-like surface), an ACP protocol that any ACP-capable client can use to drive it, and a headless CLI for scripting and CI. However, no OpenAPI or REST spec exists (every probe path returned 404), and the pack has no API or SDK reference detail. Missing for 10: a documented public API/SDK reference with endpoints or methods, an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on evidence of driving Cline through that API.
